name: Tugendhat Villa in Brno
description: Villa Tugendhat is a white, flat-roofed family home in Brno, Czechia, designed by Ludwig Mies van der Rohe with Lilly Reich and completed in 1930. Its steel-framed, open-plan living space and vast glass walls were radical for their time, and the villa quickly became a landmark of modern architecture. Visitors can walk through rooms that still show how industrial materials were used to create an elegant, light-filled home.
